FAQs for Foreign Job Seekers: Recruitment Agencies in Dubai

Understanding every aspect that surrounds recruitment agencies in Dubai for foreigners also involves clearing up the doubts you may have. Many employers have the same common questions about how these agencies work, so it’s good to clarify them before contacting them.

How can foreigners hire staff in Dubai?

As a foreign employer, you have many options for hiring employees, which are the following:

  • In-house recruitment: you can set up your HR department and do the recruitment by yourself. Nonetheless, this requires a great inversion as you need resources to do an excellent process.
  • Outsourcing: the other option for a foreign employer is to get Services for Business Hiring. By contacting a service provider you can rely on their expertise to deliver outstanding candidates.

What are the legal requirements for hiring staff as a foreigner in Dubai?

Foreign companies can hire staff as long as they comply with the following legal requirements:

  • Duly registered company in the UAE
  • Valid business license
  • Apply for an establishment card
  • Provide a valid employment contract
  • Sponsor their employees’ UAE Visa and do the application on their behalf
  • Apply for a standard work permit
  • Instruct the employees to obtain their Emirates ID
  • Register on the WPS System

Are there any restrictions on hiring certain nationalities in Dubai?

Since Dubai is a place where many nationalities meet, it is expected to have a vast array of people coming from different countries. In the UAE, it is illegal to post a job vacancy specifying a preferred nationality.

For this reason, the UAE encourages foreign employers to diversify their workforce. Meaning that they should not discriminate among nationalities but instead hire people from different backgrounds.

Do I need to sponsor my employees’ visas as a foreigner hiring staff in Dubai?

As a foreign employer, you are responsible for sponsoring your employees’ visas. This is because they will come to the UAE to work for your business, thus, you are responsible for them.

Nonetheless, before sponsoring your employees’ visas you have to meet the following:

  • Set up your business and acquire your license
  • Verify the employee has the professional skills needed for the job
  • Sign an employment contract
  • Apply for the labour card
  • Apply for the work permit
  • Get the residence visa on the employee’s passport

What are the typical salary ranges for employees in Dubai?

The average salary for employees in Dubai varies depending on the type of job and experience. It is common to find the following range:

  • Entry-level jobs range from AED 5,000 to AED 12,000 per month
  • Mid-level jobs range from AED 12,000 to AED 30,000 per month
  • Senior-level and executive jobs start from AED 30,000 and can go up to AED 100,000 per month.

How can I find qualified candidates for my business in Dubai?

Finding top candidates in Dubai can be challenging as the talent market is large but it is difficult to filter it. As such, companies can apply the following strategies to maximize their search:

  • Job portals: in Dubai, there are many job portals where you can post your vacancies. It is a great way of getting started, but it may be time-consuming to evaluate all of the applications.
  • Company’s website: you can post your vacancies on your company’s website and have your own career portal. This may be effective, but you may not receive many applications depending on your brand and reputation.
  • Social media: using social media as a hiring tool may give good results. In addition, it can boost your search.
  • Recruitment agencies: if you want to find high-quality candidates, the best you can do is rely on recruitment agencies in Dubai for foreigners.

How long does the hiring process typically take in Dubai for foreigners?

The hiring in Dubai may last from a few days up to a few weeks, based on how streamlined your process is. For some companies, it can take up to 35 days, whereas for others it can take 2 weeks.

For this reason, if you want to speed up your hiring, then you need to look for recruitment agencies in Dubai for foreigners that can help you enhance your results.
